fx.title: FX Rates
fx.subtitle: View and sync exchange rates

empty.noPairsDesc: Add your first currency pair to start tracking exchange rates.
empty.noMatchesDesc: No pairs match the current filter.

addPair.title: Add New Currency Pair
addPair.providerInfoBanner: Providers automatically fetch exchange rates from central banks. Without a provider, you will need to insert rates manually.
addPair.noProviderWarning: No provider configured. You will need to manually insert exchange rates for each date.
addPair.createIntermediatePairsHint: Each step of the selected chain routes will be saved as a standalone pair with its provider, so they can be synced independently.
addPair.createConflict: Someone else changed this conversion route at the same time. Nothing was saved — please try again.
addPair.alreadyExists: This pair already exists — sync or edit it from the FX page.

sync.description: Synchronize exchange rates from configured providers for the selected date range.
sync.tooltipFetched: Rate data points downloaded from the provider
sync.tooltipChanged: Data points actually inserted or updated in the database
sync.requestTimedOut: Request timed out after {seconds}s. Increase the timeout and retry.
sync.overwriteWarning: {existing, plural, one {# of {total} already has} other {# of {total} already have}} data stored in this range: syncing replaces it with the provider's values, manual edits included.

route.title: Conversion Routes
route.unusableHint: These providers have no automatic conversion path for this currency pair.
route.noRoutesAvailable: No automatic conversion routes found for this currency pair. You can still save without a provider and insert rates manually.
route.chainWarning: Chain routes require ALL intermediate steps to succeed during sync. If any provider fails, the entire chain fails for that date.
route.noSearchResults: No routes match the search query

fx.deletePairWarning: This will remove the provider configuration and all historical exchange rates. ⚠️

fxDetail.noData: No rate data available for this range.
fxDetail.swapConfirmMessage: You have unsaved changes in the rate editor. Swapping direction will discard them. Continue?
fxDetail.noDataManual: No data available — insert rates manually
fxDetail.syncDisabledManual: Sync disabled — no provider configured. Add a provider or insert rates manually.
